title: Evaluation of the exact open adjunction unit in fixed tower coordinates
statement: Fix a prime ell, a finite extension E of Q_ell and a section-model base b as in [def-sp-tower-shriek-data]. Let j:U → T be an open immersion, g its recorded Geometry, and o an Open operation with its specified ordinary adjunction, ordinary evaluation comparisons and termwise derived unit. For every n and every object C in the ordinary unbounded derived category of coefficient systems on U, evaluation of the derived unit, followed by the specified pullEvaluation at j_!C and finite inverse image of openEvaluation at C, equals the unit of the finite derived open adjunction at C_n. The finite adjunction is obtained from finiteOpenAdjunction by canonical right derivation and the exact-pullback comparison rightDerivedFunctorIsoMapDerivedCategory. This asserts only one adjunction-unit equation: it has no tensor, projection arrow, compactification, Tor hypothesis or invertibility assertion.

source.place: Paragraph (3), evaluation of the open projection transpose; Open.unit_evaluation and Open.unit_termwise

proof.text: Substitute Open.unit_termwise and the definition of openEvaluation as exact localization of its ordinary comparison. Transport generic pullEvaluation_model through Geometry.coefficients, transitions and pull_eq; ordinaryPullEvaluation_eq for both Geometry and Open identifies the ordinary comparison used there. Apply Open.unit_evaluation degree by degree to complexes. Naturality and the associativity and identity laws of mapDerivedCategoryCompIso cancel the localization comparison factors. The finite right-derived adjunction transported along rightDerivedFunctorIsoMapDerivedCategory has the same localized ordinary unit by its canonical unit factorization. Equality descends along the ordinary derived localization, yielding the displayed unit equation. This uses the universal property of localization, not faithfulness of tower evaluation.

lean.statement:
theorem open_adjunction_unit_evaluation (b : Base l E)
    {U T : Scheme.{u}} {j : U ⟶ T} [IsOpenImmersion j]
    {g : Geometry l E b j} (o : Open l E b j g) (n : ℕ) (C : D l E U) :
    (Ev l E U n).map (o.derivedAdjunction.unit.app C) ≫
        (g.pullEvaluation n).hom.app ((openD l E b o).obj C) ≫
        (proEtaleConstantRingDerivedPullback (R l E n) j).map
          ((openEvaluation l E b o n).hom.app C) =
      (Adjunction.unit
        (((finiteOpenAdjunction l E b j n).mapDerivedCategoryRightDerivedAdjunction).ofNatIsoRight
          (proEtaleConstantRingPullback (R l E n) j).rightDerivedFunctorIsoMapDerivedCategory)).app
        ((Ev l E U n).obj C)
